en.crisis_message: Your safety is the priority. Please call 999 or a crisis line immediately. You are not alone.
en.disclaimer: I am an AI assistant. If you are in immediate danger, please call 999.

lg.crisis_message: Obukuumi bwo bwe busooka. Tukirira eddoboozi 999 oba essimu y'okuyamba amangu. Toli weka.
lg.disclaimer: Nze munnayuganda wa AI. Bw'oba mu kabi akatungire, tukirira 999.

sw.crisis_message: Usalama wako ndio kipaumbele. Tafadhali piga simu 999 au msaada wa dharura mara moja. Huko peke yako.
sw.disclaimer: Mimi ni msaidizi wa AI. Ikiwa uko hatarini, tafadhali piga simu 999.
